test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'KING' is coded as '16181320', and 'HOP' is coded as '191211'. How will 'STA' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'KING' is coded as '16181320'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b01387ce7d21686d2c6ad1e44448e72da7d2a7e9f6352c40459d50b14e15689.png] 

'HOP' is coded as '191211'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e3b63b2bf5966bbe47c4029636b2eaa6e5f690edf896f068b282f5cf0147bad.png] 

Similarly, for STA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3d522b91dcf44397c91f3e1e432a81ed1b62962b4a2b19a38250fdaa2fe3df8.png] 

So, 'STA' will be written as '8726'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
